description: Exploit and crux test (W1/W5: is early low resolution close to free?). Run it on the E027 tip, or on the tip plus any booster above that was kept with at least +0.15 pp held-out. Change only the resolution split from 20/24/28/32 px at 15/25/30/30% of steps to 30/10/30/30%. The 28 px and 32 px phases keep their exact step counts and positions, and the LR and Lookahead schedules are unchanged. The 20 px graph is already captured in build, and error_on_recompile stays on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2. Keep only if seeds 0–2 clear 0.753 and the held-out mean stays at or above 0.752 (the 40-seed official bar of 0.75 then has at least 0.2 pp of headroom).
